item.title: Jetour Pakistan Launches Limited-Time New Year Package
item.description: Jetour Pakistan introduces limited-time incentives for buyers booking the X70 Plus or Dashing SUVs in January 2026. The company offers benefits totaling PKR 200,000 per vehicle. These include free vehicle registration, valued at approximately PKR 175,000, and an additional New Year gift worth PKR 25,000. item.title: Karachi Adopts Solar Solution for Street Lighting on Sharea Faisal
item.description: The Karachi Metropolitan Corporation has initiated a large-scale solar street lighting project on Sharea Faisal as part of efforts to improve urban infrastructure and reduce reliance on conventional electricity.
